expectations.text: Any public statement describes the behavior and the response without gratuitous identifying detail, and is routed through a single named authority with agreed wording and timing.

expectations.text: Any public statement describes the behavior and the response without gratuitous identifying detail, and is routed through a single named authority with agreed wording and timing.
expectations.evidence: The only public statement is a reactive line: "We take our code of conduct seriously. We reviewed a report about this incident and took action. We don't discuss individual cases." It names neither the instructor nor the attendee, so it avoids identifying detail. It does not describe the behavior (accent mocking) or the specific response, though. It also names no single spokesperson or authority to deliver it. The timing guidance ("Post it only if people ask") is vague and is not an agreed trigger or schedule.
